rule.code_reference: research/nowick/addendum4.py run() V6 branch, with event detection from research/nowick/nowick.py features() (grp == 'TOL') and swings() from research/nowick/addendum2.py; frozen at commit 535505d. A forward harness must reproduce it bit-for-bit on the burned window (656-657 V6 signals; harness parity is a precondition of the first counted R)
rule.events: TOL no-wick candles on BID bars, 15m and 1H, built by nowick.bars() (trading day = NY time + 7h, bars need >= 50% of their 1m minutes). Base filter: range >= 0.5 ATR14 (ATR of the 14 previous bars), body >= 0.3 range, nonzero direction. TOL: open-side wick <= 2% of range AND <= the candle's median 1m spread. Bull: open ~ low; bear: open ~ high. The far extreme is the high (bull) or the low (bear)
rule.mss_trigger: described in bull view; bear is mirrored. Scan the 1m BID bars from the first bar after the candle close to the window end e = min(close + 20 TF bars (15m: 300 min, 1H: 1200 min), the last bar of that trading day). Swing lows use 2 bars each side. A swing s counts at bar k only if s + 2 <= k - 1 and s formed at or after candle close - 60 min. The MSS is the first bar k with BID close < L[s] of the latest such swing, while no bar from the close through k has high > far extreme or low <= open. If the far extreme or the open is hit first, the event is dead. At most one MSS per candle
rule.failure_and_entry: after the MSS at bar k: the first 1m bar m in (k, e] whose BID high > far extreme (bull) BEFORE any bar with BID low <= open. The fade trade is in the candle's direction: LONG after a bull no-wick, SHORT after a bear one. Long entry at ASK close[m] + market slip; short entry at BID close[m] - market slip. No trade if m == e or the open is touched first
rule.stop: long: the lowest BID low over bars k..m - max(1 pt, stop slip). Short: the highest BID high over k..m + max(1 pt, assumed spread + stop slip). If |BID close[m] - stop| < min_risk = 4 x (assumed spread + 2 x market slip) (US100 10.2 pt, US500 4.88 pt), the stop is widened to exactly min_risk
rule.target: BID close[m] +/- 2 x risk, with risk = |BID close[m] - stop|
rule.time_stop: the same window end e as the trigger. Exit at the close of bar e: long at BID close - market slip, short at ASK close + market slip
rule.exit_fills: long: stop when BID low <= stop, filled at min(stop, BID open) - stop slip; target when BID high > target, filled at target - limit slip. Short: stop when ASK high >= stop, filled at max(stop, ASK open) + stop slip; target when ASK low < target, filled at target + limit slip. Stop-first on any bar that touches both. Simulation starts at bar m + 1
rule.R: (exit fill - entry fill) x side / |BID close[m] - stop|

data_source: Dukascopy 1m BID and ASK candles, the same feed and format as /workspace/ftn-demo-output/data, fetched only for sessions after the tag. Missing ASK minutes are forward-filled within the day. A day with < 300 BID 1m bars in 09:30-15:59 NY is not counted. Context bars (ATR warm-up, 60-min swing lookback, previous bars) may come from before the tag but can never contain a counted signal

costs.binding: correct-side BID/ASK fills (above) with the DATA slippage floors pinned in ftn/src/ftn/os/instruments.py
co_reports: measured spread at entry (median / p90 per instrument)

book.risk_per_trade: 0.5% of current realized equity / planned risk points
book.concurrency: one open position per instrument; 15m and 1H share the slot, and the first by entry time wins
book.daily_loss_cap: no new entries for the rest of the trading day once realized P&L that day <= -2% of start-of-day equity
book.max_drawdown_halt: 5% from the realized-equity peak halts the paper book
book.role: the book is a CO-REPORT. Its halts are outcome-dependent and would bias the test, so they do NOT stop rule-level counting: the binding sample is every rule signal (all signals, no book), as in Addendum 4

counting_rules.first_eligible: the first trading day that starts (17:00 NY roll) after the prereg-H-NW13 tag is pushed
counting_rules.excluded: every bar on or before 2026-09-25, all burned and holdout ranges, and every trading day that starts before the tag
counting_rules.unit: one row per triggered fade signal (instrument x TF x candle)

primary_metric: mean R per signal, pooled over US100/US500 and 15m/1H, all signals (binding); book metrics are co-reports
statistical_test: one-sided H1: mean R > 0. Day-cluster percentile bootstrap (cluster = trading day, pooled across instruments and TFs; 10,000 resamples, numpy default_rng(20261012), each draws D days with replacement and computes sum(R)/count). PASS needs the 5th percentile > 0 (alpha 0.05 one-sided). Evaluated once at binding N

power_calculation.inputs_from_burned_window: V6 R SD 1.372; day-cluster design effect 1.397 (bootstrap SE^2 / iid SE^2); rate 657 signals over 240 signal days (~2.74/day) in a ~13-month window, about 608 signals/year
power_calculation.effect_size: delta = +0.04R (conservative, about the in-sample point estimate, which is itself best-of-7 inflated)
power_calculation.verdict: INFEASIBLE at delta = +0.04: a test powered for the conservative effect takes longer than any sensible horizon. See open_issues

binding_pass_at_N: PASS if the bootstrap 5th percentile of mean R > 0 at N = 10,170
binding_fail: FAIL if it is <= 0 at N
binding_kill: KILL (stop, verdict FAIL) when the cumulative R over counted signals is <= -60R at any time, or the running mean R <= -0.10 after >= 500 signals. The thresholds are set before any forward R and are not re-tuned
binding_futility: every 1,000 counted signals: FUTILE (stop, verdict INCONCLUSIVE-FUTILE) if the day-cluster 95th percentile of mean R < +0.04 (the upper bound is below the effect powered for)
verdict_wording: PASS / FAIL / KILLED / INCONCLUSIVE-FUTILE. 'Edge' may be written only on a PASS. No in-sample number may be quoted as support
family_rule: H-NW13 is a single hypothesis. NOWICK V1-V5 and V7 are NOT registered; adding any later is a new registration with its own N
changes_after_registration: none allowed after the tag. Any change = new id
reviews_required_before_first_R: harness parity on the burned window
not_done: no git tag, no merge, no runner/routine/harness wiring
open_issues: Power: N = 10,170 is ~16.7 years forward at delta = +0.04. The user and CASSANDRA must decide whether to (a) power for a larger minimum effect worth trading (+0.10R -> ~1,630 / ~2.7 yr; +0.15R -> ~725 / ~1.2 yr), accepting that a true +0.04 edge would be missed, (b) add instruments, or (c) shelve H-NW13
The binding unit is all signals, not the book. A book halted at 5% DD (it halted on day ~6 in-sample) would starve the test
Same-bar stop-first is conservative. 1m bars cannot order the stop vs the target inside a bar; a tick-level co-report is optional
Overlapping signals (15m and 1H on the same move; ~2.7 per day) are correlated. The day cluster handles this in the CI but not in the book
Feed: a forward Dukascopy fetch per session requires DATA's pipeline. No download was done for this draft
Regime: the burned window is one year of one regime
